90:   auto write_path(const std::filesystem::path& p, FormatContext& ctx,
91:                   format_specs<Char> specs, detail::arg_ref<Char> width_ref,
92:                   const std::basic_string<PathChar>& native) const
93:       -> decltype(ctx.out()) {
94:     switch (width_ref.kind) {
95:     case detail::arg_id_kind::none:
96:       break;
97:     case detail::arg_id_kind::index:
98:       specs.width = detail::get_dynamic_spec<detail::width_checker>(

100:       break;
101:     case detail::arg_id_kind::name:
102:       specs.width = detail::get_dynamic_spec<detail::width_checker>(
103:           detail::get_arg(ctx, width_ref.val.name), ctx.error_handler());
104:       break;
105:     }
106: 
107:     auto out = ctx.out();
108:     auto emit = [&](basic_string_view<Char> s) {
109:       auto data = s.data();
110:       auto size = s.size();
111:       if (specs.precision >= 0 && detail::to_unsigned(specs.precision) < size)
112:         size = detail::code_point_index(s, detail::to_unsigned(specs.precision));
113:       bool is_debug_type = specs.type == presentation_type::debug;
114:       size_t width = 0;
115:       if (specs.width != 0) {
116:         if (is_debug_type)

119:         else

121:       }
122:       return detail::write_padded(
123:           out, specs, size, width,
124:           [=](detail::reserve_iterator<decltype(out)> it) {
125:             if (is_debug_type) return detail::write_escaped_string(it, s);
126:             return detail::copy_str<Char>(data, data + size, it);
127:           });
128:     };
129: 
130:     if (p.empty()) return emit(basic_string_view<Char>());
131: 
132:     if (!debug_) {
133:       if constexpr (std::is_same_v<Char, char> &&

135:         auto converted = detail::to_utf8<wchar_t>(

147:       auto buf = basic_memory_buffer<wchar_t>();
148:       detail::write_escaped_string<wchar_t>(std::back_inserter(buf), native);
149:       bool valid = detail::to_utf8<wchar_t>::convert(

part.text:
The fix works. Summary of changes:

**`include/fmt/std.h`** — added `g` (generic) and `n` (native) presentation type support to the `std::filesystem::path` formatter:
- `parse` now accepts `?`, then `g`/`n` type specifiers, storing `g` in a new `generic_` flag (include/fmt/std.h:174-195)
- `format` passes `p.generic_string<path::value_type>()` instead of `p.native()` when `{:g}` is used (include/fmt/std.h:198-204)
- `write_path` now emits the passed string directly when `Char == PathChar` (so generic form is honored), and uses `p.generic_string<Char>()` in the mixed-width and debug paths (include/fmt/std.h:136-160)

**`doc/api.rst`** — documented the new `g`/`n` specifiers.

All 20 tests in the build tree pass, including the new `std_test.path` cases for `{:n}`/`{:g}`, and a smoke test printing `|{}|{:?}|{:8}|{:n}|{:g}|` produces the expected output.
